reviews.title: It’s Helping Me in a Big Way
reviews.text: Sep. 20, 2026 — I purchased a year’s subscription about a week ago and am thinking, I will never let this app go.  It’s helping me so much.  But it’s hard to describe how it works; there are multiple steps and actions and to get the results, you have to do all of them and be very honest about what’s going on with you.  For me — It brings clarity when I am confused and overwhelmed.  It rewords a lot of things I am work toward and gives it a boost and deeper understanding.  I find it very encouraging.  It address soul things.  It creates a larger context for my life so I’m not drowning in anxiety of minutia.  The things it brings up and the encouragements it offers, stay with me during the day.  It’s like every morning, I get boosted for the day.  I get similar help at night.  I was looking for what this app offers, but I could not really put words as to what I was looking for.  Once I started using it, I understood what I was looking for.  It perfectly supports my needs.  Very grateful!

reviews.title: Too many bugs and issues
reviews.text: Honestly I was looking forward to an app that will assist me to get organized and help keep my mornings in check and on task, but I might as well do that with a paper and pen because this app has so many bugs that need to be fixed. First of all, when I want to add a task to morning routine, that task will completely disappear and appear for the next day, but I can’t edit it or delete it on the next day at all! Also it gives you the option to make any task “time scheduled” meaning it should let you input a time manually, but the only time it allows me to input is 1600 (4pm) time. Anything else I try to put will just keep reverting back to 1600 and I don’t know why!!!! It has to be a bug or a glitch. I also hate that I can’t manually put my tasks in order of what task I want to complete first. Don’t bother getting or paying for this app. It needs a lot of fixing.

reviews.title: Can’t change past days information.
reviews.text: I’m enjoying this app so far. The only suggestion is the ability to change past days. I wasn’t done with my day and I can’t edit it or even say I accomplished anything which is very frustrating. I’m a night time person so I don’t go to bed till around 2 a.m. and the days automatically jumping to the next day and not letting me update the day before is a problem for me. I also would like to see a little more in this app. Is it worth the money? Not really. I can copy and paste the prompts into a note book and do it there for free. I think it’s lacking in the ability to converse with others, track important information like recipes for being “healthy.” I mean there is a challenge that talks about being healthier yet there isn’t much guidance in how to do that. I would like suggestions for meals like maybe a green kale smoothie, or a rice bowl with tuna and other stuff. I see this app having a lot of potential but as of right now it’s just an aesthetic notes app rather than a life changing set up. Also one more thing. With the moon ritual stuff. That’s a great idea, but you gotta make it more complex. I mean the month of June is the strawberry moon and is best used for capricorns and earth signs. Maybe make a section that talks about earth signs, what is good and bad for them, and how this sign impacts other signs. Also set a clear ritual that goes with the moon phase, this is all stuff I had to do myself and when I’m paying an app it really should do some of this for me. Anyways. The app has some way to go but I’m looking forward to what’s to come. I’m wishing you the best of luck in making a product that can be used for healthier life styles.
